name: dossier-report
description: dossier-report: turn a research question into one published, uniquely-themed HTML page — a Dossier paid+free deep-research panel read in full, compiled into a claim graph, then designed from scratch around its own subject and published to <slug>.fledgeling.app. Ships three readings of the same argument over one claim graph (Primer / Brief / Technical), toggled by the reader, each independently and fully cited from one shared registry and working with JavaScript off, opening with a required TLDR band. Product and buying research also ships a verdict layer: three ranked picks per buyer category plus one overall winner with its cost and its weaknesses, where a paywalled Which?/RTINGS/Choice verdict counts as high-value evidence and every ranking renders as a marked inference. Every page gets its own visual language, light and dark both measured, GSAP as a hard requirement covering micro-interactions and choreography, conditional three.js behind a six-test gate, figures through dataviz in native CSS/DOM, hand-authored SVG or TanStack Charts compiled to static SVG at build time, imagery taken from the research sources with full provenance plus captioned media-gen-pro stills and clips, claim-local citations with source popups, a verified source registry, a measured divider-gutter rule, and the Dossier/Margin marketing chrome. Layout direction comes from a Mobbin trawl with a took/left ledger and /trawl divergence, routed through design-craft and ux-craft.
